subject: planner: simplify the plan cache code for fast point get (#54838)
summary: Reviewed the diff in `pkg/planner/core/plan_cache.go` and `pkg/planner/core/plan_cache_utils.go` (and minimal callers for context). Change removes the special PointGet-plan bypass stored on `PlanCacheStmt` and routes PointGet through normal plan-cache lookup with `paramTypes`; privilege-check skipping is now tied to presence of a cached PointGet executor. No remaining Blocker/High correctness, privilege/visibility, session/txn, or concurrency issues found in the planner behavior touched by this commit.
